description: Two CV recorders on a common clock: each captures a voltage into a loop and plays it back at whatever speed the clock is running.

params.text: How much the CLK jack moves that speed.
The speed the loop plays back and records at.
The voltage written into the first loop while it is recording.
How much the MOD1 jack moves the voltage written into the first loop.
The voltage written into the second loop while it is recording.
How much the MOD2 jack moves the voltage written into the second loop.
Chooses what the module does: up records into the first loop, middle plays both loops back, down records into the second loop.

inputs.text: Records into the second loop while it is high, whatever the switch is set to.
Records into the first loop while it is high, whatever the switch is set to.
A clock to run the loops from; a rising edge here restarts the loop, and the CLOCK knob is then read as a division of it.
Moves the loop speed, by as much as the MOD knob beside CLOCK allows.
Moves the voltage written into the first loop, by as much as the MOD knob beside CV1 allows.
Moves the voltage written into the second loop, by as much as the MOD knob beside CV2 allows.

outputs.text: The second recorded loop played back.
The first recorded loop played back.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
Nothing is stored until you record: put the switch up or take REC1 high to write the first loop, down or REC2 high for the second, then return the switch to the middle to hear them back.
